items.reply: The PR changes parser.go to use the new stub, whose RunCommands always fails, making every nonempty query reaching NewSQLCommand emit rawSQL at warning level. Previously, valid table-referencing queries logged their SQL at debug level, suppressed by the default info threshold. The unchanged warning therefore gains exposure through changed execution logic; this is not merely a pre-existing logging defect. Dashboard expressions can contain sensitive literals, and dashboard visibility does not establish equivalent access to server logs. High follows the rubric for a security weakness requiring specific conditions.
